For independent stylists

Your suite. Your business.

Move-in special: 1 month free rent

Private suites in Preston Hollow

Seven luxury chairs in private suites across from Preston Hollow Village. Run your own brand, set your own prices and hours, and give your clients a space that feels like a retreat.

  • Private suite with floor-to-ceiling windows and lake view
  • Part-time or full-time options, flexible terms
  • Client-ready stations, patio and shared studio areas
  • Prestige Preston Hollow location, high foot traffic
  • Supportive community of independent stylists and barbers
